item.title: CD sales are making an unexpected comeback amid a retro tech boom
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: U.S. CD revenue jumped 58.6% in the first half of 2026, reversing last year’s decline as interest in retro tech and physical media continues to grow.

item.title: Krafton doubles down on India with another $250M bet beyond gaming
item.dc:creator: Jagmeet Singh
item.description: Krafton's planned investment in India is set to surpass $500 million with its latest commitment.

item.title: Google’s Gemini Spark can now manage your Google Photos library
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Gemini Spark can edit and curate photo albums, create shared collections, turn photos into calendar events, and handle other Google Photos tasks for AI Pro and Ultra subscribers.

item.title: Less than 24 hours to apply for your TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 Side Event
item.dc:creator: TechCrunch Events
item.description: Less than 24 hours left to apply to host a Side Event during TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 and make your mark in the Silicon Valley scene. Apply before the application closes tonight at midnight PT.

item.title: US military disabled ad tracking on troops’ devices following reports of targeted attacks
item.dc:creator: Zack Whittaker
item.description: A senator's letter confirms the U.S. military moved to prevent the tracking after foreign adversaries used location data to target troops.

item.title: Feds launch investigation into Tesla’s Cybercab deployment
item.dc:creator: Sean O'Kane, Kirsten Korosec
item.description: The investigation was launched just a few hours after Tesla put the first production Cybercabs on the road in Austin.

item.title: The sameness problem behind those unappetizing AI-generated menus
item.dc:creator: Amanda Silberling
item.description: While restaurant owners might look to generative AI as a shortcut to sprucing up their menu, customers can viscerally sense that something is wrong with the food.

item.title: Crusoe reportedly raises $3B at a $30B valuation
item.dc:creator: Marina Temkin
item.description: The round came together after the data center developer reportedly secured a $13 billion contract with Jane Street.

item.title: Oura files to go public
item.dc:creator: Lucas Ropek
item.description: The ring maker says that its business has shown significant revenue growth over the past year.

item.title: Tesla is asking people if they want to buy and run Cybercab fleets
item.dc:creator: Kirsten Korosec
item.description: The company published a form on its website Thursday soliciting info from people who are interested in "Cybercab fleet vehicle purchasing."

item.title: Startup ARR is less secure than ever, new research shows
item.dc:creator: Julie Bort
item.description: The AI era has completely broken enterprise buying patterns, and startups haven't yet figured out how to navigate.

item.title: The Cybercab is Tesla’s ‘fork in the road’ moment
item.dc:creator: Sean O'Kane
item.description: The company is about to formally launch the gold two-seater, with no steering wheel or pedals -- a move that could change Tesla forever.

item.title: Accel reportedly in talks to lead $1B round for Thinking Machines at $40B valuation
item.dc:creator: Marina Temkin
item.description: The high-profile startup's annual revenue run rate stands at over $100 million.

item.title: Utilities are racing to link up with fusion startups, with Realta Fusion the latest to benefit
item.dc:creator: Tim De Chant
item.description: The grid has been straining under the weight of new AI data centers, and that has utilities courting fusion startups.

item.title: Abliteration.ai is making a business out of removing AI guardrails
item.dc:creator: Rebecca Bellan
item.description: Abliteration.AI is making powerful AI models without guardrails easier to access, arguing that giving defenders the same tools as bad actors could ultimately improve cybersecurity.

item.title: Meta is paying to peek at how you use their latest AI model
item.dc:creator: Tim Fernholz
item.description: For its new Muse Spark model, intended for operating coding and other agents, Meta is offering an explicit discount averaging out to about 95% for users who "contribute" to the development of future models by sharing their prompts and model outputs.

item.title: OpenAI launches Astra, its powerful (and controversial) new model
item.dc:creator: Lucas Ropek
item.description: OpenAI claims that Astra represents "a new frontier on computer and browser use," and that it handles tasks with unmatched "speed, accuracy, and safety."

item.title: Qualcomm backs Ultrahuman in $70M round on bet to turn smart rings into computers
item.dc:creator: Jagmeet Singh
item.description: Ultrahuman is targeting a $200 million annual revenue run rate by January 2027 as it builds a new Qualcomm-powered smart ring.

item.title: Circular unveils Ring 3 series with contactless payments and on-finger vibration alerts
item.dc:creator: Aisha Malik
item.description: The Circular Ring 3 series announcement comes amid a year of heightened competition in the smart ring market, following the launches of the Oura Ring 5 and RingConn Gen 3.

item.title: Ollie is betting its focus on privacy can help it win the AI assistant race
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: The family-focused AI assistant wants access to the details of your everyday life, but says it won’t use that data to train AI models or share it with others.
